body: Stopped before edits. C25 accessor receives result only and must return ten_point_must/points/ippon, but _finish_fight's result dict carries decision_type and scorecards, not scoring_profile/style. PostFightRead can do this only because it receives outer fight_state. A real judo result therefore cannot satisfy S4 without guessing. Please stamp scoring_profile/style into result (preferred one-line producer fix) or widen get_scorecard_read to accept the profile/fight_state.
topic: C25 BLOCKED - result omits scoring style
